title: Shaded Beige 16-Inch Glass Shelf With Towel Bar And Solid Brass Gallery Rail - Wall Mount - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep everyday bath essentials organized while adding a dedicated spot for towels—backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty — available in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. This wall-mounted glass shelf pairs tempered glass storage with an integrated towel bar for a clean, space-saving setup.

  • Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Adds a practical towel bar below the shelf for hand towels and washcloths
  • Delivers an enduring upgrade with solid brass hardware that outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives
  • Finishes the wall neatly with concealed screw mounting hardware

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection for a coordinated look.

Specs

  • Product type: Wall-mounted glass shelf with towel bar
  • Dimensions: 16 in L x 5 in projection (depth) x 12 in H
  • Glass: 3/8 in (0.38 in) tempered glass
  • Material: Brass hardware with solid brass gallery rail
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting; screw size #8 X1 1/4"
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: False
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
meta_description: 16-inch wall-mounted glass shelf with towel bar, 3/8-in tempered glass and solid brass gallery rail. Concealed mounting, 4 lb capacity, warranty.
